message.content:
The loop assumes segments arrive in ascending order. `missing` (line 9) and the grow (line 10) are computed from `last`, but line 11 indexes `a->segments[segno]` directly. If a segment number arrives out of order (segno ≤ last, or larger than the grown size), the index can be negative or beyond the container's size — an out-of-bounds write. The core flaw is the unchecked indexing at line 11.

Answer: 11
